name: Sigma

urls.caption: Virtual Incision MIRA (surgical system integrating Sigma)

description: Haptic devices using a parallel kinematics delta platform for translation and an active motorized wrist and gripper providing up to 7 active DOFs with force and torque feedback. Designed for OEM integration into surgical consoles and teleoperation workstations, such as the Virtual Incision MIRA surgical system.
